name: desk-plan
description: Claude Code mod that asks for plan approval (ExitPlanMode) in a card above the prompt instead of the full-screen engine dialog, with the plan open in desk-look's preview pane: 1 approves, 2 views the plan, type what to change to send it back, 9 for the engine dialog. Needs desk-look

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the plan card. auto follows desk-look's language

notify.title: Plan notification
notify.description: Send a notification when the plan card opens (the same channel the engine dialog uses, preferredNotifChannel). off turns it off
